name: WI-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Gwen Moore seeking another term
Prediction markets price Moore near 97% to win
Republican challenger Tim Rogers has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Milwaukee-based WI-04 leans Democratic by 26 points and Gwen Moore is a long-serving incumbent, while markets price her at roughly 97% and the Republican challenger shows no measurable fundraising. Nothing in the evidence suggests a competitive race.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or an unexpectedly well-funded challenger could narrow the margin, though not enough to threaten the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Gwen Moore has held this Milwaukee-area House seat since 2005, and the district's partisan lean of 26 points Democratic makes it one of the safest Democratic seats in Wisconsin. She is running for reelection with over $1 million raised this cycle, while Republican Tim Rogers reports no fundraising activity and an independent candidate is also on the ballot.

Prediction markets put Moore's chances near 97 percent, and no expert raters or general-election polls flag the race as competitive. The forecast rests on the district's fundamentals and incumbency, pointing to a comfortable Moore win in the mid-to-high twenties in margin.
